reference_sql:
WITH cohort AS (  -- one row per account created in the cohort months
  SELECT account_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE) AS cohort_month
  FROM accounts
  WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
),
active AS (  -- one row per cohort account and month with a usage week
  SELECT DISTINCT c.account_id,
         date_diff('month', c.cohort_month, CAST(date_trunc('month', w.week_start) AS DATE)) AS month_offset
  FROM cohort c
  JOIN usage_weekly w ON w.account_id = c.account_id
)
SELECT c.cohort_month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.month_offset = 0 THEN a.account_id END) AS m0,
       CASE WHEN c.cohort_month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL
            ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.month_offset = 1 THEN a.account_id END) END AS m1,
       CASE WHEN c.cohort_month + INTERVAL 2 MONTH >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL
            ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.month_offset = 2 THEN a.account_id END) END AS m2,
       CASE WHEN c.cohort_month + INTERVAL 3 MONTH >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL
            ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.month_offset = 3 THEN a.account_id END) END AS m3
FROM cohort c
LEFT JOIN active a ON a.account_id = c.account_id
GROUP BY c.cohort_month

WITH cohort AS (  -- one row per account created in the cohort months
  SELECT account_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE) AS cohort_month
  FROM accounts
  WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
),
flags AS (  -- one row per cohort account, 1 for each month offset with a usage week
  SELECT c.account_id, c.cohort_month,
         MAX(CASE WHEN date_diff('month', c.cohort_month, w.week_start) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS u0,
         MAX(CASE WHEN date_diff('month', c.cohort_month, w.week_start) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS u1,
         MAX(CASE WHEN date_diff('month', c.cohort_month, w.week_start) = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS u2,
         MAX(CASE WHEN date_diff('month', c.cohort_month, w.week_start) = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS u3
  FROM cohort c
  LEFT JOIN usage_weekly w ON w.account_id = c.account_id
  GROUP BY c.account_id, c.cohort_month
)
SELECT cohort_month,
       SUM(u0) AS m0,
       CASE WHEN date_diff('month', cohort_month, DATE '2026-01-01') <= 1 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(u1) END AS m1,
       CASE WHEN date_diff('month', cohort_month, DATE '2026-01-01') <= 2 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(u2) END AS m2,
       CASE WHEN date_diff('month', cohort_month, DATE '2026-01-01') <= 3 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(u3) END AS m3
FROM flags
GROUP BY cohort_month

solver.query:
WITH coh AS (
  SELECT account_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE) AS cohort_month
  FROM accounts
  WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
),
um AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT account_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', week_start) AS DATE) AS use_month
  FROM usage_weekly
  WHERE active_users > 0
),
cells AS (
  SELECT c.cohort_month, c.account_id, k.off,
         CAST(c.cohort_month + k.off * INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE) AS tm
  FROM coh c, (SELECT unnest([0,1,2,3]) AS off) k
)
SELECT cohort_month,
       CASE WHEN CAST(cohort_month + 1 * INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE) - 1 > DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL ELSE COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE off = 0 AND um.use_month IS NOT NULL) END AS m0,
       CASE WHEN CAST(cohort_month + 2 * INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE) - 1 > DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL ELSE COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE off = 1 AND um.use_month IS NOT NULL) END AS m1,
       CASE WHEN CAST(cohort_month + 3 * INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE) - 1 > DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL ELSE COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE off = 2 AND um.use_month IS NOT NULL) END AS m2,
       CASE WHEN CAST(cohort_month + 4 * INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE) - 1 > DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL ELSE COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE off = 3 AND um.use_month IS NOT NULL) END AS m3
FROM cells
LEFT JOIN um ON um.account_id = cells.account_id AND um.use_month = cells.tm
GROUP BY cohort_month
